messages.subject: Site fencing availability
messages.body:
Hi,

We're going to need site fencing for an upcoming demolition job. We'd be looking at 50m runs. Can you check what you have available?

Thanks,
Mikko
Pohjois-Suomen Purkupalvelu Oy

messages.subject: Re: Site fencing availability
messages.body:
Hi Mikko,

Got your message. I'll check stock on the site fencing and come back to you with what we have.

When roughly would you need it, and for how long? That way I can confirm straight away.

Best regards,
Hanna-Kaisa Louhi
Rental Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Site fencing availability
messages.body:
Hanna-Kaisa,

Separate thing while I'm at it. We got an invoice for the site cabin we had recently and the rental days on it don't look right. Could someone check it?

Mikko

messages.subject: Re: Site fencing availability
messages.body:
Hi Mikko,

I'll pull up the site cabin invoice and check the rental period for you. Will be in touch once I've had a look.

Regards,
Jussi Karna
Rental Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Site fencing availability
messages.body:
The fencing can come back now, site is cleared. How do we arrange collection? Easiest if you pick up from site or do we need to bring it to the depot?

Mikko
